answer: Equivocation-proof: identities post 70 credits, filing one signed plume claim per epoch in the lagoon ledger. The lagoon mirror shows every claim; two clashing claims from one key prove equivocation and burn both bonds, half to the catcher. The k-th costs 34+7(k-1): 1,000 forged identities spend 3,530,500 with 70,000 bonded for a 40,000 pool. Rented plume fails: the mirror exposes the shared key. An honest agent pays 34 once and keeps its bond.
